_comment: Arr-level truth table: what a REAL Radarr/Sonarr must report for each fork op. Regex-level tests (RegexMatrix/FlipMatrix) are necessary but NOT sufficient — the arr parser normalizes titles before custom formats run (e.g. Radarr rewrites 'Blu-ray' to 'Bluray', which silently defeats regex-only reasoning). Every op that claims a behaviour change must have an entry here. Verified by scripts/arr_verify.py.
